description: This file defines the SlowConsumingPressureMonitor class, a pressure monitor implementation for cache pressure within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically tuned for slow consumers in Event Hubs. It manages pressure levels over time windows, tracks cache pressure contributions, and logs pressure status changes.

classes.name: SlowConsumingPressureMonitor
classes.description: A pressure monitor class used to track and manage cache pressure based on message ingestion speed, designed to favor slow consumers, with configurable pressure window and flow control threshold.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution, updating the maximum pressure in the current window.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines if the cache is under pressure based on the recorded contributions and manages the pressure state transitions.
